title: Huntington levee FEMA revision boundary and current map zones
scope: The FEMA revision polygon and clipped current NFHL flood zone records with the same source citation. This file does not reconstruct the superseded map or make a finding for any particular building.
coordinate_reference: GeoJSON longitude and latitude in WGS 84
area_method: Intersect in source GeoJSON coordinates, union by published map class, measure in WGS 84 / UTM zone 18N (EPSG:32618). Percentages use the entire LOMR area as the denominator, rounded to 0.1 percentage points.

events.scope: Fairfax County reports FEMA issued the revision.
Federal notice records the map modification for Alexandria and unincorporated Fairfax County. Fairfax reports shaded Zone X for the levee-protected area.
FEMA summary lists incorporation into Alexandria panel 5155190037F.

properties.ZONE_SUBTY: AREA WITH REDUCED FLOOD RISK DUE TO LEVEE
